newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI chief meets top Finance official.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI chief meets top Finance official.

text.p: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) chairman D.R. Mehta met Finance Secretary Montek Singh Ahluwalia on Wednesday, a Finance Ministry official said.
No details about the meeting in the Indian capital were available.

Late on Monday, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said the government would announce new economic policy measures this week before he and Finance Minister P. Chidambaram leave to attend the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland on January 31.

Earlier on Wednesday, a SEBI official in Bombay said the stock market regulator was due to hold a board meeting on Thursday in the financial capital to discuss, among other issues, a new takeover code.
At Thursday's meeting SEBI will also discuss a stock lending scheme, an amendment to the country's share depository act and a report on short sales, the official said.

Analysts in Bombay said earlier this week that among steps to reinvigorate the market, they were expecting companies to be allowed to buy back their shares to reduce equity overhang. The market was also expecting taxes on shareholders' dividends to be scrapped, they said.
